## 3. Selected Professional Projects

### HealOS.ai — Healthcare AI Automation Platform

HealOS.ai is an AI-powered healthcare automation platform designed to support clinical and administrative workflows.

Luis worked on:

- Python / FastAPI backend services
- Healthcare AI workflows
- RAG and document processing
- Structured data extraction
- Validation
- Background processing
- Job tracking
- Human-review workflows
- PostgreSQL / pgvector
- Healthcare API integrations
- Cloud infrastructure

The engineering approach treated AI output as part of a controlled workflow rather than allowing model responses to directly control sensitive healthcare operations.

---

### LedgerLens — Financial SaaS Platform

LedgerLens is a financial SaaS application that processes uploaded bank statements in PDF and CSV formats.

The platform converts financial documents into structured transaction data that can be searched, categorized, reviewed, and analyzed.

Luis worked across:

- Document ingestion
- Transaction extraction
- Data normalization
- Categorization
- Validation
- Backend APIs
- PostgreSQL
- Search
- User-facing SaaS workflows
- AI-assisted financial analysis

A major engineering concern was handling different bank statement formats while maintaining a consistent internal transaction model.

---

### GaugePro.io — Industrial B2B SaaS

GaugePro.io is an operational SaaS platform for heavy-duty maintenance and repair businesses.

The product includes:

- Asset management
- Preventive maintenance
- Diagnostics
- Service orders
- Inventory
- Reporting
- Operational workflows

Luis contributed across backend services, APIs, business logic, database design, and application workflows.

The project required translating complex real-world maintenance operations into maintainable software without duplicating business rules throughout the application.

---

### AI Customer Support Automation Platform

Luis also developed an AI-powered customer support workflow that automates parts of the support lifecycle.

Capabilities include:

- Ticket classification
- Knowledge retrieval
- RAG
- Source-grounded responses
- Workflow orchestration
- Conversation summarization
- Escalation
- Human approval

- Workflow monitoring

Technologies include OpenAI, LangGraph, Python, vector retrieval, and backend workflow services.

## 5. Engineering Approach

Luis focuses on building systems that remain reliable after they leave the prototype stage.

Key engineering principles include:

- Keep AI reasoning separate from critical business logic.
- Validate model output before downstream use.
- Design clear boundaries between external integrations and internal data models.
- Use explicit workflow states and failure handling.
- Make retries safe and idempotent.
- Keep production workflows observable and traceable.
- Design APIs and databases around maintainability rather than short-term shortcuts.
- Use automated testing and CI/CD for production-critical changes.
- Prefer incremental improvements over unnecessary rewrites of working systems.

---
